{{Quote|There are slaves, dozens of them. The Brothers are loading them into shuttles--Imperial shuttles! We have to stop them!|[[Arn Peralun]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:BK" />}}
The '''Brothers Slave Processing''' was the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] processing center of the [[The Brothers|Brother]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. The area was [[Mission to Mek-Sha|attacked]] by the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Arn Peralun]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:BK" />
